note: URLs are official regulator sources (EC / EMA / EUR-Lex / FDA). Each entry may carry a direct_url and/or a discover rule that finds the current PDF link on the document's landing page. If a direct_url goes stale, the downloader falls back to discovery automatically.

documents.title: EudraLex Volume 4, Annex 22: Artificial Intelligence (draft for consultation)
documents.issuer: European Commission / EMA GMDP Inspectors Working Group (with PIC/S)
documents.notes: First EU GMP text written specifically for AI in medicinal product manufacture. Consultation closed 2025-10-07; still in development as of 2026-08 (EMA multistakeholder workshop 2026-06-30/07-01). Confirm the current version on the landing page before relying on it.

documents.title: EudraLex Volume 4, Annex 11: Computerised Systems (draft revision for consultation)
documents.title_ko: EU GMP 부속서 11: 전산화 시스템 (개정 초안)
documents.issuer: European Commission / EMA GMDP Inspectors Working Group
documents.notes: Companion to Annex 22 — Annex 22 sits on top of Annex 11 controls (validation, audit trail, supplier oversight, cybersecurity).

documents.title: EudraLex Volume 4, Chapter 4: Documentation (draft revision for consultation)
documents.notes: Published in the same 2025-07-07 consultation package as Annex 11 and Annex 22. No stable direct URL recorded — resolved from the EudraLex Volume 4 page.

documents.title: EudraLex Volume 4, Annex 11: Computerised Systems (version currently in force)
documents.title_ko: EU GMP 부속서 11: 전산화 시스템 (현행 발효본)
documents.notes: The legally applicable Annex 11 until the revision is adopted. Resolved from the EudraLex Volume 4 page because the historical direct URL has moved between ec.europa.eu and health.ec.europa.eu.

documents.title: Reflection paper on the use of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in the medicinal product lifecycle
documents.title_ko: 의약품 전주기에서의 인공지능 활용에 관한 리플렉션 페이퍼
documents.notes: EMA's cross-lifecycle position, including the manufacturing phase. Read together with Annex 22.

documents.title: Concept paper on the revision of Annex 11 (Computerised Systems) of the GMP guidelines
documents.title_ko: GMP 부속서 11 개정에 관한 콘셉트 페이퍼
documents.notes: Explains the drivers behind the Annex 11 revision, including AI/ML and cloud.

documents.title: Guiding Principles of Good AI Practice in Drug Development (EMA copy)
documents.title_ko: 의약품 개발에서의 우수 AI 실무 지침 원칙 (EMA 배포본)
documents.notes: Ten joint EMA/FDA principles issued January 2026. The FDA copy is catalogued separately as fda-good-ai-practice.

documents.title: Artificial intelligence workplan to guide use of AI in medicines regulation (EMA/HMA)
documents.notes: Regulatory roadmap rather than a binding requirement. Resolved from the EMA AI landing page.

documents.title: Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 laying down harmonised rules on artificial intelligence (AI Act)
documents.notes: Horizontal AI law that applies alongside GMP. For another language, swap /EN/ in the URL for the target locale (e.g. /DE/); EUR-Lex has no Korean version.

documents.title: Considerations for the Use of Artificial Intelligence To Support Regulatory Decision-Making for Drug and Biological Products (draft guidance)
documents.title_ko: 의약품·생물학적제제 규제 의사결정 지원을 위한 인공지능 활용 고려사항 (초안 지침)
documents.notes: Risk-based credibility assessment framework for AI models, explicitly covering the manufacturing phase. Comment period closed 2025-04-07; still draft as of 2026-08 — check the landing page for a final version.

documents.title: Discussion Paper: Artificial Intelligence in Drug Manufacturing
documents.notes: The closest FDA counterpart to Annex 22 on the manufacturing side — not binding guidance.

documents.title: Guiding Principles of Good AI Practice in Drug Development (FDA copy)
documents.title_ko: 의약품 개발에서의 우수 AI 실무 지침 원칙 (FDA 배포본)
documents.notes: Same content as the EMA copy; kept separately so both official sources are archived.

documents.title: Computer Software Assurance for Production and Quality System Software (final guidance)
documents.title_ko: 생산 및 품질시스템 소프트웨어에 대한 컴퓨터 소프트웨어 보증 (최종 지침)
documents.notes: Risk-based validation approach for production/quality software; the FDA analogue to the Annex 11 validation expectations. An updated version was issued 2026-02-03 — the landing page always serves the current one.

documents.title: Artificial Intelligence-Enabled Device Software Functions: Lifecycle Management and Marketing Submission Recommendations (draft guidance)
documents.title_ko: AI 기반 의료기기 소프트웨어 기능: 전주기 관리 및 시판 신청 권고사항 (초안 지침)
documents.notes: Device-side total product lifecycle expectations. Relevant if the AI system is itself a regulated device or is reused across device and drug operations.

documents.title: Predetermined Change Control Plans for Machine Learning-Enabled Device Software Functions (final guidance)
documents.title_ko: 머신러닝 기반 의료기기 소프트웨어의 사전 변경관리 계획 (최종 지침)
documents.notes: The reference model for managing planned model retraining/changes without a new submission — useful precedent for Annex 22 change control.

documents.title: Data Integrity and Compliance With Drug CGMP: Questions and Answers (final guidance)
documents.title_ko: 데이터 무결성 및 의약품 CGMP 준수: 질의응답 (최종 지침)
documents.notes: Baseline CGMP data integrity expectations that AI training and inference data must still satisfy.

documents.title: Part 11, Electronic Records; Electronic Signatures - Scope and Application (final guidance)
documents.notes: Records and signature requirements that apply to AI system outputs used in GMP decisions.
